## What happened

Change notice CHG-0120 records a reporting change titled “HbA1c reported in mmol/mol”. The change applies from 2021-04-01. From that date, HbA1c results are reported using the updated unit of measurement.

## Cause

The change was required because of a Lab analyser replacement. The replacement resulted in the reporting format being updated for HbA1c results.

## Effect

Values before the change are percentages. Results recorded from 2021-04-01 should therefore be interpreted using the updated reporting format, rather than being compared directly with earlier percentage values without appropriate conversion or clinical context.

This notice should be considered when reviewing historical HbA1c results or comparing results across the change. Questions about the notice should be directed to the service desk, quoting reference CHG-0120.
